title: ReleasePublished
description:
Payload of `sites.release.published.v1`: a new release of a site became current.

A fact. `ratatoskr-sites` writes it in the same transaction that makes the release current, and
never for a build whose release equals the current one. It carries no page title, slug, vault
path or page content (workspace spec `site-publications`, "The release event carries no
content"); every other member is refused. The enclosing envelope carries the owner as
`tenant_id` and the aggregate `site:<site_id>`.

`Deserialize` is hand-written because `publication_ids` must be sorted and hold each id once.

page_count.description: The number of pages in the release.

publication_ids.description: The publications whose pages the release holds, in ascending order, each once.

published_at.description: The instant at which the release became current, from the sites service clock.

release_id.description:
The new current release: the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 form of its
`sites/release.v1` document.

site_id.description: The site whose current release changed.

PublicationId.title: PublicationId
PublicationId.description:
The id of one publication of a site: 3 to 40 lower-case ASCII letters, digits and `-`.

The owner chooses the id and writes it in the manifest and in the path of
`PUT /v1/sites/{site}/publications/{publication}`.

SiteId.title: SiteId
SiteId.description:
The id of one site: 3 to 40 lower-case ASCII letters, digits and `-`.

The grammar is the `site:<site id>` form of `WriteOrigin` in `ratatoskr-notes-contracts`.
The owner chooses the id, and it appears in every route under `/v1/sites/{site}/`.

WireTimestamp.title: WireTimestamp
WireTimestamp.description: An instant on the wire: RFC 3339 in UTC with the literal `Z` designator. Exactly one spelling is accepted per instant — an input that does not re-render to itself is rejected. The field holding it declares the clock authority.
